commercial_clauses.source_fact: As a Crown corporation, the Bank is required to comply with the Accessible Canada Act (ACA). All digital learning content developed must comply with digital accessibility standards including CAN/ASC - EN 301 549:2024, EN 301 549:2021, and Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG).

commercial_clauses.source_fact: All Service Provider resources involved in the delivery of services must have the ability to meet the Bank's Reliability clearance requirements. This will include electronic fingerprints, a criminal record check, a credit check, and potentially a security screening interview.
